User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account registration and public details used across SplitXpense.

name.description: Human display name of the user.

email.description: User email address if authenticated or verified.

avatarUrl.description: Fully qualified HTTP URL to user profile picture.

createdAt.description: The ISO timestamp or Firestore ServerTimestamp when profile was created.

Group.title: Group
Group.description: A shared project, trip, or accommodation with multiple members tracking common expenses.

name.description: Name of the group (e.g. Room Rent, Goa Trip).

description.description: An optional description of what the group tracks.

category.description: Core theme category, e.g., trip, rent, dining, project, other.

members.description: A strictly bounded array containing the user ID of all co-payers in the group.

createdBy.description: The user ID of the creator of this group.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this group was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the group details were last adjusted.

currency.description: Primary currency used for currency calculations in this group (e.g., INR, USD).

Expense.title: Expense Record
Expense.description: An individual financial transaction added by a group member with granular split breakdowns.

expenseId.description: The expense entity ID stored explicitly.

groupId.description: Parent group ID containing this transaction.

description.description: Label details summarizing what was bought (e.g., Dinner, Train ticket).

category.description: Spending category (Food, Travel, Rent, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment, Other).

paidBy.description: The user ID of the group member who physically fronted the cash/card query.

splits.description: Detailed breakdown mapping userIds to their split share amount, optional percentages or weights.

notes.description: Optional custom texts detailing context about the transaction.

receiptUrl.description: An optional image attachment url representing the invoice receipt.

createdBy.description: Account creator who registered the transaction.

createdByUserId.description: The unique user authentication ID who created this expense.

createdByName.description: The human display name of the creator who registered the transaction.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the expense transaction details were updated.

Settlement.title: Settlement Record
Settlement.description: A payment from one user to other to zero out relative debt registers.

id.description: Unique identifier of this settlement transaction.

groupId.description: The group context where this settlement is made.

paymentMethod.description: Method used: e.g. UPI, cash, other.

Notification.title: User Notification
Notification.description: Alert triggered for expense registers, group additions, or settling updates.

id.description: Unique ID for the notice record.

message.description: Detailed text description of the alert.

type.description: The trigger event namespace: e.g. expense_added, group_joined, settle_reminder.

read.description: Whether the user reviewed the alert notification.

groups/{groupId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Granular shared expenses added inside group track records.

users/{userId}/notifications/{notificati.description: Individual notifications list associated with a user profile.
